tldr: The Moon in Sagittarius: emotions need freedom, meaning, and wider perspective.
body: With the Moon in Sagittarius, feelings move toward hope, exploration, humor, and the need to understand why something matters. Emotional safety grows when there is room to breathe and tell the truth.
gift: Optimism, resilience, candor, and the ability to find meaning without staying trapped in heaviness.
challenge: Restlessness, avoidance, and turning pain into a lesson before it has been felt.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
